name: Mano (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Mano town emblem in white: a stylised flower-like device enclosing a ring with an hourglass shape.
history: Flag of the former town of Mano in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-03-01.

features.role: Mano town emblem — a stylised flower-like device enclosing a ring with an hourglass shape
